evidence: Three non-overlapping native Claude subagents ran in parallel as the independent review: a paper-and-citation reviewer, a Lean/Haskell reviewer, and a website/release-metadata reviewer. Each reported to mcp report_task_status at start, at a mid-review milestone, and on completion. Children returned findings only; the parent owned every fix, every acceptance decision, and every external write.

Pass 1 raised 6 blocking findings across the parent and the three children: (1) website/reviews/website-self-review.json was a declared release output and was absent from the served bundle; (2) empirical-limits.tex Theorem 7.2 asserted an existence result whose proof invoked an undefined driver and coupling, and its New result 7.5 plus synthesis New result 4.7 rested on that unconstructed step; (3) README and both papers claimed every numbered claim carries exactly one of twelve labels, false for 16 of 129 numbered items; (4) README and index.html claimed the papers have no external bibliography, false against 70 bibitem entries; (5) formal/lean/Proofs.lean cited papers/drafts/empirical-limits.tex, a path outside the declared outputs and therefore absent from the release; (6) the published topic-series review cites item numbers from the pre-acceptance drafts that do not resolve in the shipped renumbered papers.
Repair, then pass 2 re-review of the corrected result. Every check below was re-run by the parent on the repaired bundle and its real output inspected; no value is inherited from an earlier receipt.

LaTeX: independent rebuild of all four sources in a clean temporary directory with latexmk -pdf -halt-on-error returned exit 0 for all four. pdfinfo reports 9 / 9 / 10 / 7 pages, total 35. Grep over the four final logs for undefined reference, undefined citation, undefined control sequence, LaTeX Warning, Overfull, Underfull and multiply defined returned zero matches.

Lean: lean formal/lean/Proofs.lean exit 0. Placeholder scan grep -nE '(sorry|admit|native_decide)' exit 1, zero matches. Axiom-declaration scan exit 1, zero matches. #print axioms over all eight theorems reports only propext and Quot.sound, with closeAt_symm depending on no axiom at all; no sorryAx, no Classical.choice, no user-declared axiom.

Haskell: ghc -fno-code -fforce-recomp -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wcompat -Widentities -Wincomplete-uni-patterns -Wincomplete-record-updates -Wpartial-fields formal/haskell/Core.hs exit 0 with zero warnings. The Lean/Haskell reviewer additionally ran negative controls proving both gates are live: an injected false Lean theorem fails with exit 1, and an injected unused binding fails GHC under -Werror with exit 1, so the zero-warning and exit-0 results are meaningful rather than no-ops.
Receipt integrity: shasum -a 256 -c over all ten recorded digests in receipts/latex.json and receipts/formal.json returns OK for every file, recomputed after repair.

Byte identity: diff -r on papers/latex against website/papers/latex, cmp on all four PDFs, cmp on Proofs.lean and Core.hs, cmp on all four receipts and all three duplicated review records against their website copies. Zero mismatches.

Website: html-validate exit 0 with zero output; csstree-validator exit 0 with zero output. The website reviewer verified both tools genuinely inspect their input by running them against deliberately broken files, obtaining exit 1 with 8 HTML errors and 2 CSS errors respectively. sips reports og.png at 1200 x 630; the image was also rendered and inspected visually and is a purpose-drawn card, not blank and not letterboxed.

Link integrity on the repaired bundle: 47 anchors, 37 local file targets, 0 dead local links, 0 dead fragments, 0 external or absolute links. 21 files in the bundle, 0 present but unlinked. 8 JSON records parse, 0 failures. All 24 relative README links resolve from the repository root.

Hygiene: zero occurrences of /Users/, ghp_, gho_, xoxb or other credential patterns anywhere in README.md, website/, receipts/ or reviews/. Zero script tags, zero @import, zero @font-face, zero external resource URLs; the only http-scheme string is the SVG XML namespace inside the inline data-URI favicon, which is an identifier and not a fetch.

Epistemic separation was checked and holds. Definitions, axioms, assumptions, conjectures, proved results, interpretations, empirical statements, established physical results and new results remain distinct and share one counter so the type of each claim is visible at the point of use. No assumption is promoted to a theorem: the six refuted assumptions in Paper I remain labelled Assumption and carry an explicit Status: refuted. Novelty claims are hedged at the point of use rather than asserted. Mathematical admissibility is nowhere identified with physical realization, and Paper I explicitly pre-empts that misreading of its non-cartesian corollary.

Falsification attempts that did not find a defect: 70 bibliography entries were audited and roughly 25 spot-checked against known bibliographic data, all resolving to real works with correct venue, volume and year, with no fabricated citation found. Cross-reference integrity across the four papers shows 0 undefined refs, 0 duplicate labels, 0 cites without a matching bibitem. The numerical constants of empirical-limits Theorem 7.4 were reproduced by independent RK4 integration: supremum 0.513580 at t=297.23 against the paper's 0.514 near t=297, and amplification 25.42 against the paper's 25.4. The Gronwall constants 9.21, 23.03 and 2.50 were reproduced exactly.

The repaired empirical-limits construction was itself verified numerically before publication rather than asserted: with the driver prepared at (4,0) and coupling kappa = 0.01, the composite A-amplitude rises from 1 to 4.005 at t = 314.2 = pi/kappa, first crosses r = 1.5 at t = 57.4, first enters the ball of radius 0.3 about (2,0) at t = 74.3, and dwells there 1.54 in total before t = 400.

Residual limitations recorded rather than repaired, none of them blocking: receipts/formal.json process counters and receipts/recovery.json agent counts are claims about the build process with no artifact-side evidence and cannot be independently confirmed; the axe-core, Playwright responsive-layout and pointer-target checks recorded in receipts/website.json are browser-driven and were not re-run in this pass, so they are inherited rather than reproduced; the synthesis paper still has no content-level adversarial review record, its only review being the REJECT that predates its existence, and that gap is visible in the published records rather than concealed.
repairs: Added website/reviews/website-self-review.json, the missing declared output, as a byte-identical copy of the root record. Rewrote the index.html review table, which had stated the record was kept outside the bundle: the first-pass changes-required record now has its own row and its own bundle file-list entry beside the second-pass record, so the round-1 verdict is published next to the round-2 one rather than in place of it.

empirical-limits.tex: retyped Theorem 7.2 as Proposition 7.2 and supplied the driver its proof had only asserted. The proof now names the ball of radius 0.3 about (2,0) inside the annulus, the second unit-frequency oscillator prepared at (4,0), and the coupling H_int = kappa q_A q_B with kappa = 0.01, and states the resonant amplitude transfer and the numerically observed entry and dwell times. Weakened the conclusion from unbounded discrepancy to a positive lower bound, which is what the construction establishes.

empirical-limits.tex: added Remark 7.3 stating exactly what the proof does not construct, namely that scaling chi changes the dynamics inside its support and hence the dwell time, so the uniform unbounded-discrepancy claim is not proved and nothing downstream uses it. Updated the two cross-references to Proposition 7.2 in the introduction and in the holism section.

synthesis.tex: the proof of New result 4.7 repeated the same unconstructed step. It now cites the explicit Paper III witness with its parameters and carries the same explicit statement of what is not claimed.
